question: Which institution launched India’s first-ever book on sports psychology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The International Institute of Sports Management (IISM) is the first institution in India to launch a book on sports psychology.
 
• The book aims to provide insights into the mental aspects of sports and athletic performance.
 
• It covers various psychological techniques and strategies that athletes can use to enhance their performance.
 
• The book is targeted at athletes, coaches, sports managers, and students pursuing sports management courses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sports Psychology:**

 
 
• Sports psychology is the study of how psychological factors affect performance and how participation in sports and exercise affect psychological and physical factors.
 
• It involves the application of psychological principles to improve athletic performance and well-being.
 
• Common topics include motivation, performance anxiety, and the psychological benefits of sports.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Mental Training in Sports:**
 
 
• Mental training helps athletes to stay focused, manage anxiety, and maintain a positive attitude.
 
• Techniques such as visualization, goal setting, and self-talk are often used.
 
• Mental resilience can be a determining factor in high-pressure situations and competitions.
 
 
 
• **Role of Sports Psychologists:**
 
 
• Sports psychologists work with athletes to enhance performance, cope with pressure, and recover from injuries.
 
• They may provide individual counseling and mental skills training.
 
• They also work with coaches and teams to improve communication and team dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Applications Beyond Sports:**
 
 
• The principles of sports psychology can be applied to other areas of life, such as business and education.
 
• Skills like goal setting, focus, and resilience are valuable in many fields.
 
• Sports psychology techniques can also be used to improve overall mental health and well-being.
